Punjab Lecturer Admit Card 2026 Out - Download Hall Ticket at erd.punjab.gov.in - Complete Details

Important Dates

  • Online Registration Start Date : 1 July 2026
  • Online Registration Last Date (Extended) : 27 August 2026

  • Written Exam Date : 19 to 27 September 2026
  • Date : Morning Session
  • Admit Card Notice PDF : Click Here
  • Admit Card Download : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Lecturer (Group B)
  • Online Registration Start Date : 1 July 2026
  • Online Registration Last Date (Extended) : 27 August 2026

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
